    A non-split extension of T_Λ by T_Λ' #

    Fix λ₀ ∈ Λ \ Λ' with Λ \ Λ' infinite. The extension of T_Λ by T_Λ' with α = 0 and β(e_μ) = ((μ − λ₀)⁻¹, 0) (and β(e_{λ₀}) = 0) does not split (Bricks.not_splits): a splitting would make the rational function ∑ z_λ / (λ − μ) + 1 / (λ₀ − μ) constant at infinitely many μ, against Bricks.rational_vanish. With Bricks.isBrick_ext and Bricks.hom_eq_zero the extension module is a brick.
